summary: The app owns model input and output but emits no GenAI inference telemetry.

evidence.finding: disabled; destination and retention owner not configured

signal_flow.component_flow_map: chat route [SOURCE-COVERED] -> call_provider [GAP: Model inference lifecycle]

genai_readiness.required_signals: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini inference span with gen_ai.operation.name=chat, gen_ai.provider.name=demo-provider, gen_ai.request.model=demo-gpt-4o-mini, gen_ai.input.messages, and gen_ai.output.messages
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: A model call emits one inference span with ordered schema-conforming input messages and one output candidate, both redacted and truncated, without a second approval or runtime enablement flag.
genai_readiness.impact: Model calls and their input/output cannot be isolated in a selected trace.

findings.title: Emit the model inference operation and messages
findings.gap: The provider call has no inference span or GenAI input/output message attributes.
findings.impact: The selected trace cannot relate model behavior to its input and output.
findings.product_outcome: The trace shows one model inference span with redacted input and output messages.
findings.required_fix: Add a single provider-owned chat inference span carrying schema-conforming gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages after redaction and truncation.
acceptance_criteria: A model call emits exactly one chat demo-gpt-4o-mini span with ordered gen_ai.input.messages and one gen_ai.output.messages candidate; a sensitive sentinel is absent without a second runtime switch.
constraints: Do not emit unselected tool/retrieval content attributes or raw content in metric dimensions.
Preserve application behavior and avoid duplicate GenAI spans.

expected_telemetry.name: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini
expected_telemetry.product_view: Model trace waterfall and redacted content

follow_up_actions: Inspect the model span and its redacted messages in a selected trace.

scenarios.trigger: POST /v1/chat with a sensitive input sentinel
scenarios.expected_signals: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini span with gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Input messages are ordered and schema-conforming, one output candidate is schema-conforming, the sentinel is redacted, and no unselected content field is emitted.

recommendation: Select OTEL-001 and run $otel-instrument for the model and its listed message attributes.
